About the Moon Calendar

Heather fell in love with Katherine's original moon calendar, which tracked the waxing and waning of the moon. This calendar began when Heather sent photos of desert moons to Katherine in the city. Katherine printed these monotypes on her printing press.

Moon Names

  • December 2026Pocket Mouse
  • January 2027Red Barrel
  • February 2027Granite
  • March 2027Pear Blossom
  • April 2027California Poppy
  • May 2027Gambel Quail
  • June 2027Hummingbird
  • July 2027Beaver Tail
  • August 2027Coyote
  • September 2027Date Palm
  • October 2027Gopher Snake
  • November 2027Joshua Tree
  • December 2027Big Horn Sheep
  • January 2028Basin

Katherine Dale

A New York City-based artist, Katherine creates Moon Calendars inspired by Bermuda, New York, Hong Kong, and Joshua Tree. A former Naturopathic Doctor, she returned to her lifelong passion for the printing press.
